scope: Mutaciones dirigidas CPU en copia separada. Sin optimizador ni datos reales.

mutations.name: invent_zero_updates
mutations.before: optimizer_steps=internal["optimizer_steps"] if internal is not None else None
mutations.after: optimizer_steps=internal["optimizer_steps"] if internal is not None else 0

mutations.name: invent_zero_internal_time
mutations.before: internal_seconds=internal["actual_seconds"] if internal is not None else None
mutations.after: internal_seconds=internal["actual_seconds"] if internal is not None else 0

mutations.name: invent_zero_memory
mutations.before: peak_rss_bytes=internal["peak_rss_bytes"] if internal is not None else None
mutations.after: peak_rss_bytes=internal["peak_rss_bytes"] if internal is not None else 0

mutations.name: accept_missing_success_receipt
mutations.before: raise ValueError("Un lanzamiento sin recibo interno necesita un fallo explícito")

mutations.name: accept_unclosed_internal
mutations.before: raise ValueError("Un intento interno no tiene cierre confirmado")
